name: 10 Academic Way

facts.text: UNH Housing & Residential Life's office address is 10 Academic Way, Durham; Residential Life is listed separately at 5 Quad Way (Hitchcock Hall).

verdict: The Housing & Residential Life office address; the building itself has no recorded name, date or story.
notes: Use confirmed as the UNH Housing office. Building name, construction date and history not found; it isn't in the archives building index under this address. notunh's gazetteer also places a 'UNH Police Station' point inside this footprint. That looks stale: UNH PD lists its address as 18 Waterworks Road (see unh-police-station). A search snippet suggested UNH safety reports also list 10 Academic Way for the Office of Community Standards; I could not open those PDFs to confirm. No photos found.
judgeNotes: No photos, date or history found; generic office scores.
